source: Original RadYar code-native conceptual schematic, created 2026-10-23.
purpose: Compare conceptual distribution patterns of centrilobular, panlobular, and paraseptal emphysema.
clinicalUse: Non-diagnostic conceptual graphic, not to scale. It is not an axial CT, does not depict a patient, and must not be used to diagnose COPD.
evidence: Pattern terminology follows Lynch et al., Fleischner Society statement, Radiology 2015;277:192–205, DOI 10.1148/radiol.2015141579. The graphic is an explanatory abstraction, not reproduced source imagery.

alt.de: Konzeptskizze, von links nach rechts: zentrilobuläres, panlobuläres und subpleural-paraseptales Emphysemmuster; keine CT-Aufnahme.
alt.en: Conceptual schematic, from left to right: centrilobular, panlobular, and subpleural paraseptal emphysema patterns; not a CT image.
alt.fa: شماتیک مفهومی از چپ به راست: الگوی سنترلوبولار، پان‌لوبولار و پاراسپتال زیرپلورال آمفیزم؛ CT نیست.
